name: CollateralTreatment
description: Specifies the treatment terms for the eligible collateral criteria specified.

concentrationLimit.description: Specification of concentration limits applicable to the collateral criteria.

isIncluded.description: A boolean attribute to specify whether collateral critieria are inclusion (True) or exclusion (False) criteria.

valuationTreatment.description: Specification of the valuation treatment for the specified collateral.
